correctness.rationale: RESULT.md lines 21–47 define an anchored realization as a pair (β,L), but assert a bijection from these pairs to injections ψ alone. Fixing ψ and translating β and every support point by a field element preserves all differences and ψ, producing 2^M distinct anchored pairs. For example the [3,1,3] repetition code in F4 has 24 realizations and only six injections; direct enumeration of every anchor and ordered allowed support gave six groups of four via python /workspace/branches/independent_reproduction.py 1. The corrected bijection is with (β,ψ), or with ψ alone at a fixed β. The proof actually uses the corrected parameterization at lines 109–174: the Goppa check map has kernel C and factors uniquely into the quotient and an injection; d(C)≥3 gives distinct nonzero coordinate classes, and the inverse field-element map returns valid distinct support points. Thus the anchored count and the obstruction M<s are correct for the stated fields. The bundled example checks generated supports/kernels for selected codes, with only the frame count at degree four; it does not rescue the false anchor-forgetting statement. No uploaded code was executed.
